exposure: Compassionate and respectful care training for providers
cohort: 285 mothers in the postnatal ward of 17 public health facilities in Ilu AbaBor, Southwest Ethiopia, in 2019
finding: The proportion of respectful care during maternity care in health care institutions of Ilu Ababor zone was 47.3%, with age, occupation, planned pregnancy, mode of delivery, and receiving care from providers who had compassionate and respectful care training being independent predictors.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was an independent predictor of respectful care.
